title: Automaton Workshop

reward.description: Smoked-glass lenses in a brass frame. Everything looks sepia through them, which is how you know they're working.

hints: Give Automaton a class attribute STEAM_PER_HOUR = 10, and use self.STEAM_PER_HOUR in work(). Subclasses can just change that number!
In a subclass's __init__, call super().__init__(name, steam) before adding new attributes.
describe() is defined once in Automaton. Use type(self).__name__ to get 'WelderBot' or 'CourierBot' automatically.
